name: Faceless YouTube Channel (AI-Assisted)

yield.notes: Requires 1,000 subscribers + 4,000 watch hours for monetization. Revenue from AdSense + sponsorships + affiliate links.

flags: YouTube can demonetize channels without warning
Algorithm changes can crater views overnight

prerequisites: Basic video editing software (DaVinci Resolve free, CapCut free)
startup_checklist: Choose evergreen niche with search demand (finance, history, how-to, listicles)
Create channel and optimize About section, banner, and icon
Produce 10 videos in first 30 days using AI voiceover + stock footage + AI scripts
Optimize titles and thumbnails for click-through rate
Enable monetization as soon as threshold is reached; add affiliate links from day 1
failure_modes: Niche too competitive — videos buried in search
AI voiceover flagged as spam by YouTube
kill_criteria: After 50 videos and 12 months, fewer than 500 subscribers
Channel strike or termination by platform
sources_note: Monetization thresholds from YouTube Partner Program official docs.
